full_judgment: 25. The concept of rule of law has been upheld not only by the Courts, it has also been endorsed and adopted by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights more than half of century ago and subsequently, in 1950, by The European Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Fundamental Freedoms.
